title: Premarket futures recap, Wed Nov 18, 2026
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Summary:  
\- S&P 500 +0.6% (\~7,390); Nasdaq 100 +1.2%; Dow +0.3%; Russell 2000  
\~flat (\~2,710)  
\- VIX \~24.2; 10-yr \~5.10%; DXY \~103.8; WTI \~85; Gold \~3,767; Bitcoin \~64.1K  
\- Drivers: NVDA beat (rev $115.8B, Q4 guide \~$130B, +$150B buyback);  
AI rally (CRWV, NBIS, MU, AMD); TGT +2%, LOW -2.5%; gold -2.5%, dollar  
19-mo high; Anthropic IPO prices tonight; housing starts/pending home  
sales, Fed minutes 11 AM PT; PANW after close.  
  
  
Premarket: Nasdaq futures jump as Nvidia's beat-and-raise lifts the AI trade  
  
S&P 500 +0.6%  
Nasdaq 100 +1.2%  
Dow +0.3%  
Russell 2000 \~flat  
  
VIX \~24.2 | 10-yr \~5.10% | DXY \~103.8 | WTI \~$85 | Gold \~$3,767 |  
Bitcoin \~$64.1K  
  
Drivers:  
• $NVDA +3%: record $115.8B revenue, \~$130B Q4 guide, extra $150B buyback  
• AI rally: $CRWV +5%, $NBIS +7%, $MU +3%, $AMD +3%; $TGT +2% on  
earnings, $LOW -2.5%  
• Gold -2.5% to a 1-year low as the dollar hits a \~19-month high;  
Anthropic IPO prices tonight  
  
Today: Housing starts and pending home sales this morning, Fed minutes  
11 AM PT, Target and Lowe's reported, Palo Alto after the close.
